title: Connects on-site pages, off-site pages and mailboxes
goal: Choose a relative path, full URL, or mailto link based on the target.
summary: Assume that the current page is rooms/index.html. The site also has guides/loan.html, and provides an entrance to off-site collections and a consultation email. Offline preview uses href to check the address.
tasks: connects "Send consultation email" to the mailto address of desk@example.org.

example.code: View map Off-campus venue time slot Contact the duty team
example.note: ../ Return to the previous directory first. Addresses starting with https:// contain the destination site, mailto: is handed to the mail client.

hint: Files in the same directory are available as ./. The guides in this question are at the same level as rooms.
